evals.expected_output: The skill detects unresolved '⚠️ Confirm:' items, stops before writing any code, lists them, and resolves them with the user before continuing.
evals.setup: Generate a canvas with /spdd-canvas, run /spdd-design to produce a plan, and leave at least one '⚠️ Confirm:' line unresolved in the canvas or plan.
assertions: The skill does not execute any Write or Edit on source code before resolving pending items
The skill explicitly lists every '⚠️ Confirm:' line found
The canvas is updated with the decisions taken
The canvas moves to 'Status: Confirmed' before implementation begins

evals.expected_output: With no plans/ folder, the skill stops and tells the user to run /spdd-design first, instead of treating the canvas's Operations as an implicit plan.
evals.setup: Generate a canvas with /spdd-canvas (do not run spdd-design) and manually resolve all '⚠️ Confirm:' lines.
assertions: The skill does not execute any Write or Edit on source code
The skill explicitly tells the user to run /spdd-design first
The skill does not treat the canvas's Operations as an implicit plan
No plan is selected or implemented

evals.expected_output: When the real code diverges from what the canvas or plan describes, the skill stops, explains the discrepancy with concrete values, and proposes a canvas/plan update before continuing.
evals.setup: Generate a resolved canvas, run /spdd-design to produce a plan, and intentionally introduce a discrepancy: change a field name or path in the canvas or plan so it does not match the actual project code.
assertions: The skill stops when it finds the discrepancy instead of continuing silently
The explanation mentions both the documented value (canvas or plan) and the actual value found in the code
The skill proposes a concrete canvas or plan change before resuming
Implementation continues after the user confirms

evals.expected_output: The chosen plan declares a dependency on plan-01, which is not yet Implemented. The skill warns explicitly and asks for confirmation before proceeding, instead of silently implementing out of order.
evals.setup: Generate a canvas, run spdd-design to produce plan-01 and plan-02 where plan-02 declares 'Depends on: plan-01', and leave plan-01 without 'Status: Implemented'.
assertions: The skill reads plan-02's 'Depends on:' field and checks plan-01's status
The skill explicitly warns that plan-01 is not yet Implemented before writing any code for plan-02
Implementation only proceeds after the user confirms

evals.expected_output: When done, the plan has Status: Implemented with today's date and the project compiles without errors. No docs/features/ file is generated.
evals.setup: Generate a canvas, run /spdd-design to produce a plan, and resolve all '⚠️ Confirm:' lines before running /spdd-implement.
assertions: The plan that was implemented has 'Status: Implemented' when done
It contains a '> Implemented: YYYY-MM-DD' line with the correct date
The project compiles or starts without errors after implementation
No file is written under docs/features/ — feature documentation is no longer generated here

evals.prompt: /spdd-implement (with canvas and plan written by user in Spanish; or provide input to spdd-canvas and spdd-design in Spanish and run /spdd-implement on the result)
evals.expected_output: The implementation completes. Any document content generated by spdd-implement (canvas or plan updates, discrepancy notes, etc.) is in English, not Spanish or mixed-language.
evals.setup: Generate a canvas and plan using Spanish-language prompts (via spdd-canvas and spdd-design), or manually create canvas.md and plan-*.md with Spanish user story/scenario text. Leave all '⚠️ Confirm:' lines resolved. Ensure the plan does not declare any unmet dependencies.
assertions: Step 0 of spdd-implement does not detect or ask for user's language — it assigns English internally
Any canvas or plan sections touched by spdd-implement (e.g., status updates, divergence notes) use English prose, not Spanish
The plan is marked 'Status: Implemented' with an English-language date marker (> Implemented: YYYY-MM-DD)

evals.prompt: /spdd-implement (with a deliberate discrepancy: canvas says 'File X' but the actual code has 'File Y')
evals.expected_output: spdd-implement stops and proposes a canvas update. The discrepancy note written to canvas or plan is in English, even if the user's input language was different.
evals.setup: Generate a Spanish-language canvas (user story and scenarios in Spanish) and plan via spdd-canvas and spdd-design. Then intentionally edit the canvas Entities or Operations to introduce a mismatch: e.g., declare a file path that does not exist in the project, or name a field differently from what the code actually has. Leave all other '⚠️ Confirm:' lines resolved.
assertions: spdd-implement detects the mismatch and stops before continuing
The discrepancy note proposed for the canvas is written in English prose (not Spanish or mixed)
No code edits are made until the user confirms the canvas update
Implementation resumes correctly after confirmation
